Let $\mathrm{P}(2 \cos \alpha, 2 \sin \alpha)$, $0<\alpha<\frac{\pi}{2}$ and $\mathrm{Q}(2 \cos \beta, 2 \sin \beta)$ be two points such that $(\alpha-\beta)=\frac{\pi}{2}$.
